answer_2.quote: We use alignment-based metrics to measure how well the K generated distractors align with ground-truth human-authored ones. The first metric, Exact match (h e ), measures whether all three human-authored distractors in D are matched exactly by some subset of the generated distractors D. Similarly, Partial match (h p ) measures whether at least one generated distractor matches humanauthored ones. ... The third, continuous metric, Proportional match (h n ), measures the portion of humanauthored distractors that match generated ones, defined as h n (D, D) = | D ∩ D|/3.
